key_points: Kroger reaffirmed its 2026 outlook, reducing near-term estimate risk despite no guidance raise.
Investor Day introduced a 7%-11% annual EPS growth target through 2029, supporting a stronger medium-term earnings outlook.
The planned $5 billion investment could improve value and market share but creates execution and return-on-capital risk.
The muted share-price reaction suggests investors are still awaiting detailed targets, timelines, and evidence of returns.
Most headlines repeat the same Investor Day event; the Korean market and asset-manager sale stories are not material stock-specific catalysts.
